content:
— 200
Returned if the Tenable MSSP Portal successfully updated the domain for the specified account UUID.
— 404
Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform could not find the specified domain for the specified account
UUID.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
string
The standard HTTP error name.
account_uuid
required
domain_name
status

error
